mcqs.question: What recommendation was made by the Andhra Pradesh High Court Full Court on 24 August 2026 regarding the retirement age of judicial officers?
options: To raise it to 62 years, in line with the Supreme Court’s direction to 7 States
To retain the existing retirement age without any change
To transfer the decision to the State Apprenticeship Council
To apply the retirement-age decision only to district judges
mcqs.explanation: The Andhra Pradesh High Court Full Court recommended raising the retirement age of judicial officers to 62 years on 24 August 2026. This followed the Supreme Court’s direction to 7 States; the State Apprenticeship Council had no role in this recommendation.
